Metadata.CommitMsg:
fix(ci): derive the e2e spec path prefix from each leg's rootDir

Playwright sets config.rootDir to the project's testDir - web/e2e here - not
to the directory holding playwright.config.ts. The first implementation
assumed the latter, so every row of the new table linked to
web/a11y.spec.ts for a file that lives at web/e2e/a11y.spec.ts. Confirmed
against the repo: the emitted path 404s at that commit, the corrected one
resolves.

Caught by downloading this PR's own artifact and rendering it, not by a test
- the fixtures encoded the same wrong assumption, so they agreed with the
bug. They now carry the rootDir a real CI run produces.

Derived per leg rather than corrected in place: a runner's checkout root is
always <...>/<repo>/<repo>, so cutting the leg's own rootDir at the last
/<repo>/ yields the repo-relative prefix on Linux, Windows and macOS alike.
The summary job's own GITHUB_WORKSPACE cannot serve, since it belongs to a
different runner. Off a runner there is no marker and a documented web/e2e
fallback stands in; both paths are tested, plus a testDir one level deeper.

Signed-off-by: Ashutosh Pandey <ashutosh.pandeyhlr007@gmail.com>
